notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
